notes: Three co-transmitters at the first level are three routes into one family, so one group (rule 2).
Ubayd Allah narrates that he was there with Harith and Abdullah; those two only ask and are in the scene, so Umm Salama, who answers and relays the Prophet, is the last link.
- واللفظ لقتيبة - is a dash gloss and is left out; the remark وقال أبو جعفر هي بيداء المدينة is a commentary, not a route.
